newsitem.title: USA: GK Intelligent says hires new auditors.
newsitem.headline: GK Intelligent says hires new auditors.

text.p: GK Intelligent Systems Inc said Friday it appointed BDO Seidman LLC as its corporate auditors, effective immediately.
They will conduct audits of the company's financial statements or the fiscal year ended May 31, 1997, as well as for fiscal 1996.
GK said BDO replaces Alonzo & Wells LLP of Houston. It said the firm had agreed to resign once GK went public because it does not audit public companies.

"The decision to engage BDO Seidman as auditors is one of the requisite actions we as a company need to take in preparation to making application for listing on the Nasdaq Small Cap Market," said Gary Kimmons, president and chief executive.
